annotations.title: Publish a site again after a failed publish

description: Build the newest commit of the site's default branch again and publish it, as a push does. It runs only when the newest publish of the site failed for a cause that a new try can fix; for any other cause the refusal names the cause code (a mission's founder view gives the request that fixes it). The new deploy shows in list_site_deploys a moment later. Pass the same idempotencyKey on a retry to publish once; without one, each call is a new request. Requires the config:write capability.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string; repeat it on a retry

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites, or publishProblem.siteId of a mission

name: retry_site_publish
title: Publish a site again after a failed publish
